description: Render fade-in and/or fade-out effects onto an existing video without modifying the source file. Use fade_in for a fade from black at the start and fade_out for a fade to black at the end; output_path is created or overwritten.

crf.description: Optional FFmpeg CRF override from 0 to 51, where lower means higher quality.
crf.title: Crf

fade_in.description: Non-negative fade-in duration in seconds from black at the start.
fade_in.title: Fade In

fade_out.description: Non-negative fade-out duration in seconds to black at the end.
fade_out.title: Fade Out

input_path.description: Absolute path to an existing local video file. The input file is read only.
input_path.title: Input Path

output_path.description: Destination video path. Auto-generated when omitted; an existing supplied path may be overwritten.
output_path.title: Output Path

preset.description: Optional FFmpeg encoding preset: ultrafast, fast, medium, slow, or veryslow.
preset.title: Preset

name: video_fade
title: Add video fade
